meta.title: COD single-page starter — cash on delivery landing demo
meta.description: A zero-dependency COD landing page skeleton: hero, variant picker, delivery form and a local order preview.

hero.title: Try it first, pay when it arrives.
hero.subtitle: A clean single-product skeleton for cash-on-delivery campaigns in Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

delivery.title: 2–4 day delivery
delivery.body: Nationwide courier coverage with tracking updates.

cod.title: Pay the courier
cod.body: No card needed. Check the product, then pay at your door.

returns.title: Easy returns
returns.body: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days.

spec.title: Choose your variant
spec.subtitle: The demo carries your selection into the order preview.

form.title: Delivery address
form.subtitle: Cash on delivery. The courier will call before arrival.
form.privacy: Used only to prepare this local preview. Nothing is sent anywhere.
form.error: Please fill in your name, phone number and address.

success.title: Order preview
success.intro: This preview is generated in your browser. Connect your own order endpoint for production.
success.name: Name

faq.title: COD questions
faq.a1: No. The demo only collects a delivery address, and payment happens when the courier arrives.
faq.q2: Can I change the address after ordering?
faq.a2: In production, ask the courier to update it before dispatch. This demo does not store the address.
faq.q3: What do I need to prepare?
faq.a3: A reachable phone number and a complete street address are enough.

meta.title: WhatsApp lead page starter — chat-first landing demo
meta.description: A zero-dependency WhatsApp lead page skeleton with comparison cards, FAQ, a sticky CTA and UTM-aware chat preview.

hero.title: Questions before you order?
hero.subtitle: Skip the form. Ask a real person, get an answer, then decide.
hero.note: Demo number only — replace it with your business number.

mock.name: Support team
mock.bubble1: Hi! Ask us anything about the product.
mock.bubble2: We usually reply within a few minutes.

pain.title: Two ways to get an answer
pain.lead: A form only lets people leave; a conversation lets them ask.

left.title: Self-serve only
left.item1: Long FAQ pages you have to scan
left.item2: Forms that go quiet after submit
left.item3: No way to ask a follow-up

right.title: Chat first
right.item1: One tap opens a real conversation
right.item2: Answers in your customer's own words
right.item3: The page context arrives with the message

preview.title: Message preview
preview.label: Prefilled message
preview.note: The link keeps the current UTM parameters, so you can see which ad started the chat.
preview.invalid: This demo number is not a real WhatsApp account.

faq.title: Before you chat
faq.q1: Is this a real WhatsApp number?
faq.a1: No. The starter uses a demo number and never contacts it automatically.
faq.q2: Does the message include ad parameters?
faq.a2: Yes. The preview shows how UTM parameters are carried into the message.
faq.q3: Can I use my own number?
faq.a3: Replace the data-wa-phone attribute in the template with your business number.

message.prefill: Hi! I'm interested in the starter demo and have a question.

footer.note: The floating button stays reachable while the reader scrolls.

meta.title: PWA app landing starter — installable page demo
meta.description: A zero-dependency install landing skeleton with manifest, service worker and a beforeinstallprompt demo.

hero.title: Add it to your home screen.
hero.subtitle: A lightweight install landing page skeleton with a manifest, a service worker and a one-tap install demo.
hero.note: Works offline after the first visit.

speed.title: Loads fast
speed.body: One HTML file, no frameworks, no external requests.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: The service worker caches the shell after the first visit.

install.title: Installs like an app
install.body: The install prompt is intercepted and replayed from a button.

install.title: One-tap install
install.step1: Open this page in a browser that supports install prompts.
install.step2: Tap the install button below; the demo replays the saved prompt.
install.step3: Launch it from the home screen and reload while offline.
install.unsupported: This browser does not expose an install prompt. Use the browser menu instead.
install.ready: Install prompt captured. The button below is live.
install.waiting: Waiting for the browser install prompt…
install.installed: Installed. You can open it from the home screen.
install.dismissed: Install was dismissed. You can try again from the browser menu.

offline.title: Offline ready
offline.body: After the first visit, the service worker serves this shell from the cache.
offline.unavailable: Service worker needs http(s); this page is running as a local file.

faq.title: PWA questions
faq.q1: Why is the install button sometimes disabled?
faq.a1: Browsers only expose the install prompt after their own eligibility checks. The demo explains the fallback.
faq.q2: Does this demo need a build step?
faq.a2: No. The manifest and service worker are plain files next to index.html.

footer.note: Icons and manifest are local files; nothing leaves your browser.
